component.name: Shokzer
component.summary: Settings for the Shokz OpenRun Pro 2

description.p: Change the settings of a Shokz OpenRun Pro 2 from your Linux desktop, the way the phone app does: EQ presets, a five-band custom EQ, multipoint, and which of your devices are connected. It also shows battery and firmware.
Every change is confirmed by reading the setting back from the headset. Playback and calls stay with your normal audio setup. A command-line tool, shokzer, does the same.
Shokzer is a community project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Shokz.
First release: EQ presets, custom EQ, multipoint, battery and firmware, in the app and on the command line.
